claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mupirocin is a bacterial isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase inhibitor with no activity against eukaryotic cytoplasmic IleRS, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines.
